about.history.title: School History & Our Journey
about.history.subtitle: Three decades of excellence in education
about.history.description: Founded in 1995, Sultan Zoy High School began with a simple yet powerful vision: to create an educational institution that would nurture young minds and prepare them for the challenges of tomorrow. What started as a modest school with a handful of dedicated teachers and passionate students has grown into one of the region's most respected educational institutions. Our journey has been marked by continuous innovation, unwavering commitment to academic excellence, and a deep dedication to developing well-rounded individuals. Over the years, we have evolved our teaching methodologies, embraced cutting-edge technology, and expanded our facilities, all while staying true to our core values of integrity, respect, and excellence. Today, Sultan Zoy High School stands as a testament to what can be achieved when vision meets dedication, serving hundreds of students and contributing positively to our community and beyond.

hero.title: Security & Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Your trust is our foundation. Learn how Sultan Zoy High School protects your data and ensures privacy for all members of our community.

commitment.title: Our Commitment to You
commitment.p1: At Sultan Zoy High School, we understand that protecting the privacy and security of our students, parents, and staff is paramount. This policy outlines our commitment to safeguarding your personal information and maintaining transparency about our data practices.
commitment.p2: We comply with all applicable data protection laws and regulations, including GDPR, COPPA, and FERPA, and we continuously update our practices to meet the highest standards of data protection.

featuresSection.title: How We Protect Your Data
featuresSection.subtitle: We employ multiple layers of security to ensure your information remains safe and confidential.

encryption.title: End-to-End Encryption
encryption.description: All data transmitted between your device and our servers is protected with industry-standard SSL/TLS encryption.

storage.title: Secure Data Storage
storage.description: Student and staff data is stored in secure, encrypted databases with regular backups and disaster recovery protocols.

access.title: Access Control
access.description: Role-based access ensures that users only see information relevant to their role (student, parent, teacher, admin).

privacy.title: Privacy Protection
privacy.description: We comply with international data protection regulations including GDPR and ensure student privacy is maintained.

audit.title: Regular Audits
audit.description: Our systems undergo regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and fix vulnerabilities.

monitoring.title: 24/7 Monitoring
monitoring.description: Continuous monitoring of our systems ensures rapid detection and response to any security incidents.

notice.title: Important Notice
notice.description: This privacy policy applies to the Sultan Zoy High School website and related digital platforms. By using our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy. If you do not agree with our practices, please do not use our services. For students under 13, parental consent is required for platform usage.
